notes.title: Update 1.0.2 – Achievements & More!
notes.notes:
First off, thanks to everyone who’s been playing Isle of the Night and sharing feedback—it really helps shape the game! Now, let’s dive into what’s new:  9 New Achievements
Achievements are finally here! This is the first batch of basic achievements, covering core milestones like surviving multiple nights and progressing through the game. More will come in future updates!

New Upgrades & Powerups
I’ve added several new upgrades and powerups to keep things fresh and give you more build options during your runs. Experiment and see what crazy combos you can pull off!

Bug Fixes & Improvements
As always, I’ve squashed a bunch of bugs and made some balancing tweaks for a smoother experience.

That’s it for this update—short and sweet, but the achievements alone should give you a little extra motivation to keep pushing forward. As always, let me know what you think, and happy surviving!

notes.title: Early Access & Update 0.1.5
notes.notes:
First off, Birates is now in Early Access! I haven’t made a post about the launch yet, but I really appreciate everyone who has tried the game so far. Your feedback has been incredibly helpful, and I’m excited to keep improving the game.

Now, onto Update 0.1.5 – and this one’s a big step forward.

Save & Load is Finally Here!

https://i.ibb.co/Kp3Yf5Wn/Screenshot-2025-03-04-130633.png

By far, the biggest thing the game lacked was a save system. When I first started developing Birates, I didn’t think about it because the game was originally structured around shorter, roguelike-style runs. But as development went on, it shifted more and more into a survival game, and a single run went from lasting 1-2 hours to 5-6 hours. That made saving essential, and after a lot of work, you can now save and load your progress.

To save your game, simply place a new building called the "Tent." You can save during the day by interacting with it, allowing you to continue your progress later.


New Building Menu

https://i.ibb.co/6cRVTvV1/Screenshot-2025-03-04-130907.png

Building is now much more convenient! Instead of crafting a building item separately, you can now open the new Build Menu and place structures directly from there. This should make base-building smoother and more intuitive.


Around 10 New Level-Up Choices

To add more variety to each run, I’ve introduced around 10 new level-up choices, giving you more ways to build your character.


Bug Fixes & Balancing

I’ve made a lot of fixes and balance adjustments, so the game should feel a bit more stable now. Let me know if you run into any issues.

If you have any suggestions, feel free to reach out to me. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Demo Update: Bug Fixes and Balancing Tweaks
notes.notes:
First off, a heartfelt thank you to those of you who’ve tried the Birates demo! We truly appreciate the time you’ve taken to check it out and share your feedback—it means a lot to us, especially in these early stages.

This patch includes:


 Experimental: Limited item despawns to mob drops only.
 Experimental: Added 5 additional slots to starting inventory, also buffed bags accordingly.
 Balancing Adjustments: Small tweaks to improve the gameplay and balance, damage scaling has been reduced and projectiles should now be easier to dodge..
 Bug Fixes: I’ve resolved several issues to make the experience smoother.
 I've also made it easier to give feedback—just head to the main menu and you'll find the feedback option right there.


If you'd like to stay updated or provide feedback, I’d love for you to join my Discord channel (found below).

You can also reach out to me directly on Discord with the username 'BehaUlas' if you have any thoughts you'd like to share personally.

Thanks again for your support!
